sloka: गवाम् शत सहस्रम् च ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नराधिपः ।एक एकशो ददौ राजा पुत्रान् उद्धिश्य धर्मतः ॥१-७२-२२॥
transliteration: gavām śata sahasram ca brāhmaṇebhyo narādhipaḥ ।eka ekaśo dadau rājā putrān uddhiśya dharmataḥ ॥1-72-22॥

translations.english: For the welfare of each of his sons the king (Dasaratha) religiously gave away a hundred thousand cows to brahmins.
